The structurally-correct fuel-invariant $/MWh net-revenue markup REPLACES the fuel-scaled heat-rate-multiplier markup: each gas band's physical burn keeps full delivered-fuel tracking while the above-physical markup becomes a gas-invariant margin at the training-window anchor (offer reduces algebraically to the registered multiplier form at fuel==anchor; only the markup's gas-elasticity changes 1->0). The small C3b dur-NRMSE dip in the above-anchor years (2023 2.152->2.160, 2024 1.528->1.530, 2025 0.835->0.852) is the REMOVAL of the multiplicative form's fuel-scaled masking of the already-failing scarcity tail (rule 11, exposing not causing) — both forms miss the >$300 tail by 600-1300 $/MWh; that is the ORDC/reserve scarcity-formation lane (ERCOT-94/99), not an offer-form defect. The ORDC administrative scarcity price is itself fuel-invariant (set off VOLL/LOLP), so the fixed-margin peak wall is the structurally-faithful form. The keeper designates the most structurally faithful run; it is NOT a calibration claim. Prior frontier/lineage note follows. --- FRONTIER WITHDRAWN — ERCOT reverts to NOT-YET (owner directive 2026-07-17, the ERCOT-79 availability-envelope audit: 'we can't have a keeper on inaccurate data'). The 2026-07-17 frontier declaration rested on a keeper (ercot76) whose scarcity tail was formed on a PHANTOM CAMPD facility-outage bug: the run-based detector hard-zeroed ~1.9-5.7 GW of daily-cycling combined-cycle capability its own CEMS shows generating (T H Wharton et al.), artificially exhausting the event-time fleet so the co-opt priced into its ORDC steps. ERCOT-79 found and fixed the detector (event-based detection for cycling classes; source-faithful, measured CEMS + EIA-930, validated 58h false-outage 1,904->0 MW/h, 0% genuine-outage over-correction) and the fix was ADOPTED (corrected campd-outages.csv installed). On the corrected fleet the keeper recipe (re-solved as keeper 2026-07-17-ercot79-corrected-outages) resolves the 2023 summer over-shoot ($1,068->$242, confirming ERCOT-78) but UN-CATCHES the real scarcity tail (2023 C3c 179->53 vs RT 181, Aug caught 71->25, 2025 tail 19->0) — the offer/scarcity calibration was tuned against the phantom-tightened fleet. DETERMINATION: NOT-YET (C3a/C3b/C3c fail on accurate data). OPEN LANE (successor): a full ERCOT offer-curve + ORDC/co-opt re-calibration against the corrected availability envelope, so the real scarcity re-forms on real fleet tightness. CROSS-ISO: the detector is shared — PJM's committed facility csv shows a stronger phantom signature and all six ISOs' unit-level extracts use it; each ISO is its own regenerate-and-re-audit lane. See results/calibration/FINDING-ercot79-phantom-outage-2026-07.md.
